title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - Ukraine (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Ukraine, TB/HIV, International Charitable Foundation “Alliance for Public Health” (Alliance for Public Health)This program has the following goals: To reduce the TB and HIV/AIDS-related mobidity and mortality in Ukraine. The objectives of this program are: To scale up and ensure equitable access to high quality TB and HIV prevention, treatment, care and support with a focus on key affected populations (MARPs, PLWHA and other people most affected by the HIV and TB. To strengthen community systems that enable needs-based, cost-effective and integrated interventions for key populations mostly affected by the HIV and TB epidemic.. To strengthen the health systems towards sustainable and integrated solutions for key populations mostly affected by the HIV and TB epidemic

Percentage of sex workers who are living with HIV

TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population

Percentage of MSM reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
TCS Other-1: Number of adults currently receiving antiretroviral therapy among all adults and children living with HIV in penitentiary system
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results

Percentage of people who inject drugs that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy

Percentage of people living with HIV newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy

Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
Number of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed TB, new and relapses
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
